WaterBase.description: WaterBase provides unique properties to identify individual records of  brewing water.

producer.description: The utility or source the profile describes.

calcium.description: The concentration of calcium (Ca) in the water.

bicarbonate.description: The concentration of bicarbonate (HCO3) in the water.

carbonate.description: The concentration of carbonate (CO3) in the water.

potassium.description: The concentration of potassium (K) in the water.

iron.description: The concentration of iron (Fe) in the water.

nitrate.description: The concentration of nitrate (NO3) in the water.

nitrite.description: The concentration of nitrite (NO2) in the water.

fluoride.description: The concentration of fluoride in the water.

flouride.description: Misspelling of fluoride, kept so existing documents stay valid. Write fluoride instead; readers should accept either and prefer fluoride when both are present.

sulfate.description: The concentration of sulfate (SO4) in the water.

chloride.description: The concentration of chloride (Cl) in the water.

sodium.description: The concentration of sodium (Na) in the water.

magnesium.description: The concentration of magnesium (Mg) in the water.

WaterType.description: WaterType collects the attributes of a brewing water to store as record information

notes.description: Free text notes about the water profile.

WaterAdditionType.description: WaterAdditionType collects the attributes of each water addition for use in a recipe

amount.description: The volume of this water used in the recipe.
